categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Ultrapower Software Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two major business clusters: software and information technology services, and mobile gaming. The software and IT services segment includes AI/ICT operation management, IoT communications, and innovative services. The gaming segment focuses on strategy mobile games (SLG) with global distribution and operation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital technologies including AI, natural language processing (NLP), AIGC, 5G, cloud computing, big data, and IoT. Game development utilizes the Unity3D engine with URP pipeline rendering and integrates AI-generated content tools to enhance production efficiency. ICT operation management products incorporate AI-driven automation, digital twins, and hybrid cloud management. The information security segment develops platform-based security solutions with zero-trust architecture and AI-powered security analytics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include telecom operators, financial institutions, energy and transportation sectors, government agencies, and large enterprises. The gaming business targets global consumers, especially in the US, Japan, South Korea, Europe, Middle East, and Latin America. Software and IT services cater to B2B clients requiring digital transformation and intelligent operation solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in Mainland China and overseas markets including Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, Southeast Asia, North America, Europe, and other global regions. Its gaming products are distributed in over 150 countries and regions worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ultrapower operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the digital economy supply chain, focusing on software development, digital solutions, and game production and distribution. It acts as a technology provider and service operator rather than a hardware manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with a global layout strategy. R&D focuses on AI, cloud computing, 5G, IoT, big data, and digital twin technologies. It invests in AI large model training, intelligent operation platforms, and game development with AI integration. The strategy includes expanding overseas market presence, enhancing product quality, and exploring new digital economy applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through mobile game sales with in-app purchases, software product sales, ICT operation management services, cloud services, and IoT communication solutions. The company also earns from licensing, subscription-based SaaS platforms, and technical consulting services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ultrapower is a leading Chinese digital economy enterprise with strong positions in mobile game export and ICT operation management. Its subsidiary Shellwood Games ranks among top Chinese overseas mobile game publishers. The company holds a competitive edge through technology integration and diversified digital service offerings, competing with other domestic and international software and gaming firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 6.45 billion, an 8.22% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.43 billion, a 60.92% increase. It has shown steady growth in revenue, profitability, and cash flow, with a strong asset base exceeding RMB 8 billion. The company maintains a robust R&D investment at around 4.7% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ultrapower differentiates itself by integrating cutting-edge digital technologies into its products and services, offering high-quality, long-life-cycle mobile games with strong global appeal. Its ICT operation management solutions provide comprehensive, AI-driven intelligent operation platforms that enhance efficiency and security for large enterprises. The company’s ability to combine AI, cloud, IoT, and 5G technologies into unified digital solutions creates significant value for customers undergoing digital transformation.
